title: Verifier update from a chunk
statement: Let $N$ be a nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean input alphabet, $st$ a verifier state, and $ch$ a finite list of pairs of Booleans. The update decodes the list of first components of $ch$ as a cell value and applies the optional verifier state update to $st$ using that decoded value.
